title: Refreshed tie-mirror CVD table was computed without the shipped mode tables — all six values contradict the palcheck oracle it claims to mirror
evidence:
Mirror: "| deutan | 142.2 | 214.2 | 48 |
| protan | 191.8 | 248.5 | 48 |
| tritan | 129.6 | 86.2 | 48 |

*(recomputed 2026-08-25 from the SHIPPED bytes — Machado 2009 severity 1.0,
the same simulation `harness/palcheck.odin` runs; both pair rows are IN the
shipped palcheck oracle." — but palcheck.odin:90 applies the tables first: "// rebuild the effective palette (the shipped tables — palette_apply_mode
	rnd.palette_apply_mode(base, &eff, mode)". Replicating the exact pipeline (Machado matrices + sRGB gamma + shipped mode remaps of route_glow/state_congested) gives tie-vs-route_glow 102.8/120.8/184.8 and tie-vs-state_congested 202.1/236.5/105.0 (deutan/protan/tritan); palette.json's shipped comment independently confirms "worst route_tie pair 102.8". The mirror's six values reproduce EXACTLY when the mode tables are skipped (base tokens simulated): 142.2/214.2, 191.8/248.5, 129.6/86.2. The flagged residual "route_tie sits ~17.4 from pipe_steel under the deutan simulation" is likewise wrong — with the shipped deutan pipe_steel remap the distance is 92.0.
detail: The W1 advisory deliverable (mirror must track shipped truth) shipped numbers that match neither the oracle nor palette.json's own comment; its 'same simulation palcheck runs' claim is verifiably false (palette_apply_mode skipped).
recommended_fix: Recompute the table with the shipped mode tables applied (route_glow→[0,118,132] deutan etc.): glow 102.8/120.8/184.8, congested 202.1/236.5/105.0; drop or re-derive the 17.4 pipe_steel residual (actual 92.0).

title: Committed ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md is the raw un-instantiated template (placeholder frontmatter, guide comments intact)
evidence:
Committed file begins: "---
name: '{name}'
type: architecture-spine
...
paradigm: '{named design pattern, e.g. hexagonal, layered, pipes-and-filters, actor}'
scope: '{what this spine governs}'
status: draft
created: '{date}'" and carries "<!-- TEMPLATE GUIDE — act on these comments, then delete them; never emit a comment in the finished spine." — the sibling .memlog.md records the run as "CLOSED 2026-08-23: egress migration WITHDRAWN by user ruling".
detail: The spine is an orphan scaffold, not an authored architecture — nothing references it and its own guide says placeholders/comments must be deleted; future readers may mistake it for a real (draft) architecture. Folded verbatim by ruling, hence note-only.
recommended_fix: Rename to ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.template.md (or add a one-line withdrawn-note header) so the blank scaffold can't be read as a drafted spine.
